10 REM SL1500 PC-1500A &7C10
20 L=&7C10:S=&7D00
30 A=PEEK &7BFF:B=PEEK &7FFF:C=255-B
40 POKE &7FFF,C:Q=PEEK &7FFF:R=PEEK &7BFF
50 POKE &7FFF,B:POKE &7BFF,A
60 IF Q<>C OR R<>A PRINT "NO ML RAM AT &7C00":BEEP 3:END
70 P=2:INPUT "RX PORT (DEFAULT PB2) ";P
80 M=0:IF P=0 LET M=1
90 IF P=2 LET M=4
95 IF M=0 BEEP 1:GOTO 70
100 CLS:WAIT 0:PRINT "INSTALLING..."
105 RESTORE 1000:C=0
110 FOR I=0 TO 190:READ V:POKE L+I,V:C=C+V
112 Q=PEEK (L+I):IF Q<>V GOTO 300
114 NEXT I
115 FOR I=0 TO 120:READ V:POKE S+I,V:C=C+V
117 Q=PEEK (S+I):IF Q<>V GOTO 300
118 NEXT I
120 READ V:IF V<>C PRINT "DATA ERROR":BEEP 3:END
130 POKE L+16,255-M
135 POKE L+25,M:POKE L+41,M:POKE L+61,M:POKE L+74,M
140 P$="PB2":IF M=1 LET P$="PB0"
150 CLS:WAIT 100:PRINT "SL1500 READY 4800 ";P$
160 PRINT "LOAD CALL &7C10 NEW 1ST"
165 PRINT "SAVE CALL &7D00"
170 PRINT "SURVIVES NEW AND NEW0"
180 WAIT 0:END
300 CLS:WAIT 0:PRINT "ML RAM WRITE ERROR":BEEP 3:END
